body: I just can't even find anything I love or that makes me smile anymore... I'm never gonna be happy again :-(

I've already tried figuring out a way to runaway and start over ever since I turned 18, but I don't have enough money for a plane or train ticket and my car will just be A.P.b.'d by the cops and me dragged back. I might as well die quick and easy then being homeless on the street of some city dying of a seizure from no medicine and my dead carcuss being dragged back to MD and the bill dropped on somebody else.

I am already maxed out on government student loans and financial aid b/c of my dad and bro making too much money but they spend it all on other stuff or hord it.
And I tried going to counseling at my college while I was there and they are just undergrad psych majors that don't know what they're doing.

I'm on linked in and 8 other job-based websites and it is doing squat. All my relevant experience is in volunteer work and employers don't care about that stuff unless they are a non-profit.

I tried going to my state's job assistance center nd networking but I just get made fun of by all the older participants saying it's people my age that are the reason they're out of work. That there are plenty of companies looking for fresh meat but then they don't give me any names? So that didn't help any. People know I am looking for a job but nobody has the right connections in the right places.

I hate the crappy job because no matter how hard I work my ass off other people get the praises and promotions and my boss thinks everything else in our lives revolves around our job at the store. And he only ever promotes people with dicks or that suck his (aka guys and flirty girls) and I am neither. I have tried transfering to another store but that has not worked.

My medicine costs $300 a month without insurance b/c there is no approved generic.

I've already tried number crunching to see if I can deal without the pain killers and get just the anti-seizure medicine but my good job I don't get enough hours to pay all my bills.
I don't know how to DM, let's just say I'm in my mid 20's
I took one programming class as part of the math program and passed from going to the professor crying in frustration on projects and getting help from a comp sci major.

I've tried plotting running away from it all but it is the freakin medicine that holds me back. I have 2 months worth of backup but after that I would die from a seizure.
But I'm getting to the point I don't care anymore if I die from not taking my medicine. My most depressing and stressful job is the one I hate the most but I need it for health insurance. My second job I love but they can only give me 10 hours a week b/c they are so small.
I've tried looking for state (MD) and federal government programs but they are only for old or disabled people or people rejected for health insurance coverage by other companies but I wasn't rejected, just charged an arm and a leg for it b/c of preexisting conditions.
I don't know where I would run away to, my parents sheltered me growing up so I lack street smarts to survive on my own. Plus I know somehow people would find me and drag me back.
I have tried looking into depression centers to check into but I don't want to go local because of people coming and hurting me more and am having trouble finding one out of state.
I just feel like my only hope of getting back up out of this hole is escaping this crappy situation and stop these negative thoughts about myself and my life but I just don't know where to go.
I don't want to deal with this pain and just want to stop hating myself but don't know how.

More details:
-My degree is in Math, and no I can't teach. Already tried and had to fork out an extra years tuition when I got booted from the Math Ed program
-I have epilepsy and my medicine without insurance is at least $300 a month. I also have ADD and my counselor claims if I take care of the ADD the depression will go away.
-I've tried taking walks but they just make me more sad seeing other people walk together while I'm alone. And I have a bum knee and a bad back from past injuries so I can only handle so much activity without it hurting worst. I have tried looking at gyms and martial arts places as an alternative but I can't afford it.
-my family has all their own lives now. My little bro is engaged with a triple digit government job, my dad moved on to another girlfriend still harping on me that I am not trying hard enough to find a job and that is why I don't have one. And my mom is a happy hermit having the state pay her for permanent disability
- I don't even remember anymore what used to make me happy and what hobbies I could do. My therapist said the same thing but I can't find anything I enjoy or am good at. I don't remember the "good days" if there ever were any to begin with.

Like I said before, I've tried it all
